"""Print the size and SHA-256 of a file as JSON. Usage: python scripts/digest.py --file PATH"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--file", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
data = Path(args.file).read_bytes()
print(json.dumps({"file": args.file, "bytes": len(data), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()}))
"""Print a small JSON report for a name. Usage: python scripts/report.py --name NAME"""

import argparse
import hashlib
import json

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--name", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"name": args.name, "length": len(args.name),
                  "checksum": hashlib.sha256(args.name.encode()).hexdigest()[:8]}))
"""Print a URL slug for a title as JSON. Usage: python scripts/slug.py --title TITLE"""

import argparse
import json
import re

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("--title", required=True)
args = parser.parse_args()
print(json.dumps({"slug": re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", args.title.lower()).strip("-")}))

--- a/tests/test_rename_user.py
+++ b/tests/test_rename_user.py
@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+from app.api.handlers import handle_get_user, handle_rename_user
+
+
+def test_rename_user_ok_and_visible_via_get():
+    result = handle_rename_user({"id": "2", "name": "Renamed User"})
+    assert result == (200, {"id": 2, "name": "Renamed User", "email": "linus@example.com"})
+    assert handle_get_user({"id": "2"}) == (200, {"id": 2, "name": "Renamed User", "email": "linus@example.com"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_trims_whitespace():
+    result = handle_rename_user({"id": "2", "name": "  Spaced Name  "})
+    assert result == (200, {"id": 2, "name": "Spaced Name", "email": "linus@example.com"})
+    assert handle_get_user({"id": "2"})[1]["name"] == "Spaced Name"
+
+
+def test_rename_user_name_length_boundaries():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "3", "name": "x"})[0] == 200
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "3", "name": "y" * 50})[0] == 200
+
+
+def test_rename_user_invalid_id_missing():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"name": "New Name"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_invalid_id_non_string():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": 123, "name": "New Name"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_invalid_id_non_digit():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "12a", "name": "New Name"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid id"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_invalid_name_missing():
+    # A valid id that also names a non-existent user still yields the name error first.
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "99"}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_invalid_name_blank():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "99", "name": "   "}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_invalid_name_too_long():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "99", "name": "z" * 51}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_invalid_name_non_string():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "99", "name": 123}) == (400, {"error": "invalid name"})
+
+
+def test_rename_user_not_found():
+    assert handle_rename_user({"id": "99", "name": "New Name"}) == (404, {"error": "not found"})
